# /home/ai-core-node/.config/systemd/user/frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service
[Unit]
Description=FranKenstein Gespraechsmodus (PHASE 42b/42c Realtime Voice, Wake-Word)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=600
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/gespraechsmodus.py listener
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

# /home/ai-core-node/.config/systemd/user/frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service.d/95-voice-live-final.conf
[Service]
ExecStart=
ExecStart=/usr/bin/env python3 /home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_final_runtime.py
Environment=LOCAL_BRIDGE_MACHINE_ID=ai-core-node
Environment=LOCAL_BRIDGE_OWNER=gabriel
Environment=FRANK_VOICE_DEFAULT_INSTALLATION=gabriel
# /home/ai-core-node/.config/systemd/user/frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service
[Unit]
Description=FranKenstein Persistent Headless ChatGPT Client
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/env python3 %h/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/voice_host_live_client.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=2
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
EnvironmentFile=-%h/.config/frankenstein/chatgpt-client.env
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true

# This process owns no browser and starts no Chrome. It is the typed,
# persistent session/context endpoint behind the already-existing ChatGPT
# bridge. The loader hard-binds canonical runtime authority to the live
# ~/.claude/star/stern.py used by production; effects remain behind existing
# Frankenstein authority/effect fences.

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
